302:
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE a."element"
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
        WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
        WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
        WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
        WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
        WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
        WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
        WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
        ELSE a."element"
    END AS element
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a
    ON a."atom_id" IN (c."atom_id", c."atom_id2")
WHERE c."bond_id" = 'TR001_2_4'
ORDER BY element ASC NULLS FIRST;

    - SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');
744:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics');
772:
SELECT DISTINCT
    ec."colour" AS eye_colour,
    hc."colour" AS hair_colour,
    sc."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"
JOIN "colour" ec ON ec."id" = s."eye_colour_id"
JOIN "colour" hc ON hc."id" = s."hair_colour_id"
JOIN "colour" sc ON sc."id" = s."skin_colour_id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
  AND p."publisher_name" LIKE '%Dark Horse Comics%'
ORDER BY eye_colour ASC NULLS FIRST, hair_colour ASC NULLS FIRST, skin_colour ASC NULLS FIRST;
834:
SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(s."id")::numeric) * 100.0 AS female_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
LEFT JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" LIKE '%George Lucas%'
819:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL;
773:

WHERE s."eye_colour_id" = s."hair_colour_id"
  AND s."hair_colour_id" = s."skin_colour_id"
ORDER BY s."superhero_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

1456:
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    SUM(e."cost") AS total_spent
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = e."link_to_member"
GROUP BY m."member_id", m."first_name", m."last_name"
ORDER BY total_spent DESC NULLS LAST

1453:
WITH avg_parking AS (
    SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS avg_cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
)

SELECT ev.event_name
FROM event ev
JOIN budget b ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
CROSS JOIN avg_parking ap
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
  AND e.cost < ap.avg_cost

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'October Meeting' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC

FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
  AND e."event_name" IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');

1437:
SELECT DISTINCT

    a."link_to_event"
FROM "expense" e

    e."event_name",
    e."event_date"
FROM "expense" ex
JOIN "budget" b ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE ex."expense_description" LIKE '%Pizza%'
  AND ex."cost"::NUMERIC > 50
  AND ex."cost"::NUMERIC < 100

1451:
WITH multi_event_members AS (
    SELECT e."link_to_member" AS member_id
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    JOIN "event" ev ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev."event_id") > 1
)

SELECT m."first_name", m."last_name", e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN multi_event_members mem ON e."link_to_member" = mem.member_id
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
ORDER BY e."cost" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1
1457:
WITH avg_cost AS (
    SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost
    FROM expense
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.phone
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
CROSS JOIN avg_cost a
WHERE e.cost > a.avg_cost
